title: Smart ring maker Ultrahuman to roll out biological-age model across UAE | TechCrunch
summary: In May, the Department of Health – Abu Dhabi announced a partnership with Ultrahuman arch-rival Oura to combine the company’s wearable data with the emirate’s longitudinal health data, initially focusing on women’s health and cardiometabolic risk.
